items.title: Complete Windows GUI workflow and relaunch test
evidence: GitHub Actions run 39034556183, job 117401756236, commit 044e32bebc13e87cf147868e497a2096ab2709f6: actual packaged Windows x64 GUI completed two independent launches (PIDs 3492 and 1524), each with 10 passing checks, 5 verified compiled CLI workers and a clean exit â€” docs/CI.md and docs/ci-evidence-dev2.json; https://github.com/Swir/Maxkompilator/actions/runs/39034556183/job/117401756236

Relocated bundle outside the checkout; real PYZ/resource test, cancellation, descendant termination and reopening PASS; 17 font roles passed the 96-character glyph check in each launch, and both downloaded captures were visually checked for readable text. This completes automated GUI qualification; manual interactive and Python-free Windows release gates remain open
